status: Completed original4000 development review; wider palette helps but color/detail/real-camera limits remain
decision: Retain V43 working reference. V60 is the stronger photo/color research candidate, with unresolved moderately saturated bright-color errors and paired-real tradeoffs. Stop both arms at their original4000 boundary; no automatic schedule extension or default promotion.

result.scope: Completed palette step4000 state/data/numerical/native/RGB16 integrity audit; quality and visual selection remain separate.

result.limitations: Saved complete case logs, no new inference of old weights. Same observation keys/metadata and nullable control support; all classical drift recorded under the inherited four-float32-ULP bound, not exact replay. V43 real batch2 versus current/parent batch4; photo batch2. Neural FP16/physical FP32. These development source intervals do not quantify training seed uncertainty or multiple-comparison selection. Parent versus fine-tuned arm includes additional training; only current control versus wide isolates the palette intervention. V43 differs in initialization/history. No strict final, SOTA or broad real superiority claim.

notes.known: Both arms smooth plate-surface texture and simplify the bright reflection; the 7D panel boundaries and small point remain, with soft edges. No convincing arm difference. Independent AHD RGB is not exact GT.
notes.unseen: Both remove grain but leave broad structure and faint texture on the apple/tan surfaces. No decisive arm detail gain; independent AHD RGB is not exact GT.
notes.full427: Both erase the fine parachute cords and soften cloud wisps/building detail. Native selected photo appearance is very similar between arms.
notes.analytic: The dark carrier is almost erased; the brighter weak carrier is faint and uneven. Neutral fields are smooth. No clear arm advantage in these previews.
notes.gfx: Both smooth the sky and soften fine foliage, the building truss and chain-link mesh. The wider palette gives no compelling native detail gain. ISO100 differs in aperture/exposure and motion and is not GT.
notes.three-camera: Q2 broad dark texture is similarly smoothed in both arms and RawNIND. Sony input is already soft and window outlines remain soft. GF50R stone retains more granular variation in both arms than RawNIND, with residual grain; no clear arm difference or exact GT.
notes.prospective-grid-CUDA: Both neutral previews are smooth. Warm30deg stays close with mild broad variation. Wide magenta is visibly closer to GT than control, with remaining broad mottling. Parent/released-reference views reuse identical previously inspected PNGs; the released reference retains its earlier grid/hue artifacts.
